headline: Exchange Inflows Fell To 116.2 Million Dollars From 343.3 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in 116.2 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.0427 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, down from 343.3 million dollars and 0.1260 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means that money arrived where holders can sell. Binance took in 533.8 million dollars, down from 887.7 million, while OKX sent out 598.7 million, Bitfinex took in 133.8 million, and Gate took in 127.1 million.
author: jordan
